verdict.rationale: Throttling or queuing workflow executions is a fair axis for a workflow automation platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents execution concurrency limits, queue mode, or rate-limit controls. The closest items are error workflows and a community mention of retries, which are adjacent error-handling features, not throttling or queuing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
